title: Graffiti Alley Washi Tape
author: Velvet.Sparrow
description:
The Washi Wheel has rolled straight through the paint department and emerged in a graffiti-covered alley. Apparently, it decided that a quiet afternoon of decorating wasn’t nearly exciting enough without splashes of turquoise, electric yellow, and a few walls full of street art.
Graffiti Alley Washi Tape brings the energetic colors and bold patterns of urban street art into a coordinated assortment of printable strips. This set includes 12 individual PNG files plus one matching 12-page PDF showing those same 12 designs. Print the complete PDF for convenient trimming, or choose individual PNG files when working with particular patterns and color combinations.
The artwork features vibrant graffiti-inspired arrangements with painted brick walls, mural details, abstract shapes, colorful geometric patterns, and repeating urban designs. Electric turquoise, coral pink, lemon yellow, violet purple, and charcoal gray create a striking palette with plenty of contrast and movement.
Across the twelve sheets, the designs shift between detailed street art compositions and simpler repeating arrangements. Some borders resemble colorful alley walls filled with overlapping painted forms, while others feature bold diamonds, chevrons, stripes, circular shapes, and rhythmic abstract patterns. Bright floral forms and layered textures add another dimension to the assortment.
These printable strips are suitable for junk journal borders, contemporary scrapbook layouts, art journals, handmade greeting cards, and creative notebooks. They can also decorate urban photography albums, street art travel diaries, sketchbooks, and mixed visual compositions inspired by city life.
Combine a densely patterned graffiti border with one of the simpler striped designs to balance a page. The turquoise and coral arrangements make vivid accents against darker backgrounds, while the geometric bands provide useful framing for photographs, handwritten notes, and experimental layouts.
The collection offers a playful combination of street culture and graphic pattern design. Whether you prefer the intensity of a busy mural or the order of repeated shapes, there are plenty of ways to bring these contrasting arrangements together.
These are printable strips intended for trimming and attaching with your preferred adhesive, not physical rolls of sticky tape.
Thank you for visiting Velvet Sparrow! Please follow the shop and favorite this set if its energetic designs inspire you. Your favorites help me discover which unexpected creative directions you would enjoy seeing next.
